title: Magic vs Boldly: Pricing, Hours, and Coverage
summary: Compare Magic and Boldly assistant plans on price, scheduled hours, and after-hours support before you decide.
body_markdown:
Looking for a great executive assistant? Magic gives you a full-time remote assistant on your schedule plus an after-hours team. Boldly costs about 5 times more per hour ($65 vs $13.50), hires from North America and Europe, and sells smaller monthly hour blocks with backup for vacations and sick days. Here’s how their prices, hours, and coverage compare so you can pick the right fit.


**TLDR:**


- Magic’s Executive Assistant plan works out to $13.50 an hour ($540 a week for 40 scheduled hours). Boldly’s published plans work out to $65 an hour, which is $51.50 an hour more.
- Boldly bills project management, web development, blog writing, design and other specialist tasks at $79 an hour, which is $65.50 an hour more than Magic. Magic’s price stays the same for any work you hand off.
- Magic also includes 10 hours a week of after-hours help from Magic 24/7, with no long-term contracts and cancel anytime.


## Boldly offers assistants for a set number of hours each month


Boldly sells remote executive assistants on monthly subscription plans. Its assistants work from North America or Europe, and its[US staff are Boldly employees](https://business.review42.com/boldly/) who support executives and leadership teams.


You pick a monthly hour block that matches the recurring work you want to hand off.


Boldly’s satisfaction guarantee refunds the month’s fees if you’re unhappy.


## Magic trains an assistant to take responsibility for your work


[Magic](https://getmagic.com/blog/magic-inc-your-remote-workforce/) finds, trains, and coaches a dedicated remote assistant who works directly with you. There are no long-term contracts and you can cancel anytime, while Magic stays involved after placement so you can hand off real responsibilities like following up with leads or collecting unpaid invoices.


Our full-time[Executive Assistant plan](https://getmagic.com/executive-assistant/) gives you 40 hours a week on your schedule, selected from the top 0.5% of applicants. Your assistant uses AI to work faster, checks the output, and owns the final result. For example, they can use AI to research a prospect before calling or emailing them.


The Executive Assistant plan also includes Magic 24/7. If an urgent task comes up while your dedicated assistant is offline, you message our team of human assistants at any hour.


## Magic provides more scheduled hours for less


Magic’s Executive Assistant plan costs less than Boldly’s published plans (40 to 100 hours a month) and gives you more than four times as many scheduled hours a year as[Boldly’s 40-hour entry plan](https://boldly.com/pricing-plans) : 2,080 hours (40 a week for 52 weeks) vs 480 hours (40 a month for 12 months). For a local-hire benchmark,[BLS data on executive assistants](https://www.bls.gov/oes/current/oes436011.htm) shows a median wage of $76,590 a year in May 2025, before benefits and taxes. That’s $48,510 more than Magic’s $28,080 a year. See how[executive assistant costs](https://getmagic.com/blog/how-much-does-an-executive-assistant-cost/) compare below.

Prices are published rates checked in November 2026. Boldly’s rates assume monthly ACH payment (card payments add 2.9%), and plans above 100 hours are quoted on request.


Every Boldly plan works out to $65 an hour, about 5 times Magic’s $13.50. That rate covers executive assistant work. Boldly bills project management, web development, blog writing, design and other specialist tasks at $79 an hour. Magic’s $540 a week covers 40 hours whatever you hand off.


If you want full-time help, see[Magic Executive Assistant pricing](https://getmagic.com/pricing/) . If you’re willing to pay about 5 times more per hour and need an assistant based in the US or Europe, Boldly makes sense. For daily work like following up on unpaid invoices, a full-time Magic assistant is scheduled to work on it every day.


## Magic pairs a full-time assistant with after-hours help


Boldly’s entry plan gives you 40 hours a month, about 9 hours a week. Boldly also offers plans of 60, 80 and 100 hours a month, and quotes plans up to 160 hours a month on request. Magic’s Executive Assistant plan gives you 40 hours every week, about 160 hours a month.


Magic’s full-time Executive Assistant plan pairs 40 scheduled hours a week with 10 weekly hours from Magic 24/7, a separate team of human assistants online 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Your dedicated assistant works your agreed schedule using[executive assistant skills](https://getmagic.com/blog/executive-assistant-skills/) , and the Magic 24/7 team handles urgent requests outside those hours.


For example, your dedicated assistant follows up with new leads during scheduled hours. If you need urgent research later that evening, you can send the request to Magic 24/7. You keep recurring responsibilities with one person and have another team available outside that person’s hours.


## Magic trains your assistant and coaches them every week


Both Magic and Boldly let you meet your assistant before you pay. With Magic, you meet your assistant and choose a start date, and you pay nothing until you start working together. Boldly also starts each client with a 1-hour launch meeting and provides a trained backup for vacations and sick days. Based on publicly available information as of November 2026, Boldly’s pricing page doesn’t list ongoing assistant coaching or AI training.


At Magic, we select your assistant,[train them before they start](https://getmagic.com/blog/how-we-train-our-virtual-assistants/) , and onboard them into your tools. Magic coaches your assistant in weekly one-on-ones after placement. If you ever need a replacement, we find another assistant and handle the handover.


Every Magic assistant learns your[executive assistant tools](https://getmagic.com/blog/executive-assistant-tools/) and gets a Claude account that Magic sets up and pays for. Assistants train on Claude before they start, including checking its work before anything reaches you. Your assistant stays responsible for the results.


For example, a Magic coach can work with your assistant to automate parts of prospect research. Your assistant checks the prospect details and follows up with every lead, spending less time gathering information and more time contacting potential customers.


## Magic fits owners who want an assistant working every day


Choose Magic if you want a full-time assistant working every day on your schedule, backed by Magic 24/7 and regular coaching, for $540 a week with no long-term contracts. Boldly is a better match if you want a smaller monthly block of hours from a US or European employee and you’re willing to pay a lot more per hour, about 5 times Magic’s $13.50 an hour. If you’re also comparing Wing, read our[Magic vs Wing](https://getmagic.com/blog/magic-vs-wing/) guide.


[Book a short call](https://getmagic.com/getstarted/) with nothing to prepare. Tell us what you want to hand off, and we’ll match you with an assistant.


**When should you choose Magic over Boldly for recurring work?**


Choose Magic if you want one assistant taking responsibility for daily work, such as following up with every lead, across 40 scheduled hours a week. Boldly fits executives who want a US or European assistant for a smaller, defined monthly workload, starting at 40 hours a month.


**How do you compare Magic and Boldly costs across different billing periods?**


Magic’s Executive Assistant plan costs $2,160 every four weeks for 160 scheduled hours. Boldly’s entry plan costs $2,600 per calendar month for 40 hours. For an annual budget, Magic’s $540 weekly rate totals $28,080 over 52 weeks, while Boldly’s entry plan totals $31,200 over 12 months.


**Can you use Magic 24/7 the same way as Boldly’s backup assistant?**


The services cover different needs: Magic 24/7 handles requests outside your dedicated assistant’s schedule, while Boldly’s trained backup covers vacations and sick days. Magic’s full-time Executive Assistant plan includes 10 hours of Magic 24/7 work each week from a separate team, so your dedicated assistant doesn’t need to be online around the clock.


**How do you get started with Magic if you’re moving from Boldly?**


Book a short call so Magic can learn about your business and select an assistant for your needs. Magic trains your assistant, onboards them into your tools, and provides regular one-on-one coaching. Confirm your Boldly cancellation terms before choosing a Magic start date so you can plan any overlap.


**If you need a US-based assistant, how do Magic and Boldly compare?**


Boldly offers US or European assistants, while Magic hires assistants in the Philippines and Latin America. If US location is a requirement, ask Boldly to confirm a US-based match before you start.


**Can you get an AI-trained assistant without paying for another AI subscription?**


Yes. Magic trains every assistant to use AI tools at no extra cost to you. Your assistant uses AI for work such as prospect research and checks the results before delivery.


**What if you want an assistant but don’t have time to train someone?**


Magic trains your assistant before they start and onboards them into your tools. A short call gives Magic the business context it needs to select an assistant for your goals.


**Can you try Magic without committing to a long-term contract?**


Yes, Magic has no long-term contract, and you can cancel anytime. You pay nothing until you start working with your assistant; if you’re dissatisfied within the first two weeks, Magic makes it right or gives you a full refund.


**What if you eventually need several assistants for your business?**


Magic Teams provides three or more assistants with custom hiring, training, scheduling, and a success coach from day one. For example, you can build a team for round-the-clock customer support as your needs grow.


**Should you delegate an entire follow-up process or send your assistant individual tasks?**


Delegate the recurring responsibility when you want your assistant to keep following through without a new request each time. For example, your Magic assistant can research prospects and follow up with every lead, bringing you in when a decision needs your input.


**How do you send an urgent request to Magic 24/7?**


Log into Magic and message the Magic 24/7 team directly with your request. Full-time Executive Assistant plans include 10 hours of work from that team each week, which you can use for tasks such as urgent evening research.


**What happens if you need a replacement Magic assistant?**


Magic finds another assistant and handles the handover of your work. You don’t need to run a new hiring process yourself.


**How does your Magic assistant check AI-generated work?**


Your Magic assistant reviews AI output before delivering it and remains responsible for the result. For example, they check AI-generated prospect details before using those details to follow up with a potential customer.


**How do you set your dedicated Magic assistant’s working hours?**


Magic’s Executive Assistant plan provides 40 hours a week on your agreed schedule. Discuss the hours you need on your setup call so Magic can select an assistant for that schedule.
